# Issue

Issue #3794: Analyzer panics on grpc-go: resolution site has no positioned identifier (typed_fact_lowering.rs:3472)

The analyzer panics on grpc-go during a policy run:

```
thread 'bifrost-parse-32' panicked at crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/typed_fact_lowering.rs:3472:32:
site 643 has no positioned identifier
```

The panic is the `unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("site {site} has no positioned identifier"))` in `identifier()`: a resolution site reaches typed fact lowering without a positioned identifier fact.

## Reproduce

Seen at d7447cba4 (origin/master after the 2771 landing, plus Go race changes that do not touch `resolution/` or `store/`), on four runs: grpc-go-1316-bytes-received and grpc-go-1667-subconns-map, buggy and fixed revisions, from the #2904 benchmark. grpc-go buggy commit for 1667: `1e1a47f0f28f70686674869a7dee0f1096d86919` (https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go).

```
bifrost_benchmark go-race run --manifest benchmark/go-data-races/targets.toml --case grpc-go-1667-subconns-map --output <dir>
```

The case applies a small authored test harness (`benchmark/go-data-races/harnesses/grpc-go-1667-subconns-map/harness_test.go`) before analysis; the panic may also occur without it (not checked). Full stderr: `/tmp/go-d7447-measure/grpc-go-1667-subconns-map/*-policy.stderr`.

The same grpc-go cases ran to completion without a panic at 1683f0dc6 (2026-09-30), before the 2771 landing.

Expected: no panic. If the site legitimately lacks an identifier, the lowering should report an incomplete fact instead of panicking.

Binding projections are read at lines 3122-3199 and around 4901-4916. I'll read the second block, which has a `callable_value_reference` check, and look for any identifier lookup on the projection's reference.

`validate_projection` calls `index.reference_identifier(fact.reference)` for every binding projection, so any projection whose reference is an identifier-less callee panics there. Line 5346 is a second `TargetCallableResultType` push, in a different function from the one the commit guarded. I'll read that function to see whether its callee can be an identifier-less site.
All three callee arms of `finish_ambiguous_generic_instantiation` use positioned sites, so that push is safe. I'll check the other projection emitters at 4040, 4675-4730, and 5663 the same way.

These emitters all use `add_identifier_site`, so their references are positioned. The commit guards the only unpositioned case, and the base has no other unguarded one that I can find.
